title: L2: small Playwright page timing script for test servers
public_pr_body:
Adds a standalone script for dashboard, jobs, timesheets and customers: five cold and five warm navigations each, median, slowest and raw samples. Documents test authentication, cache/readiness definitions and comparable before/after use; fails redirects/error/unfinished screens without a partial median. No automatic CI job added.

Validation: Node syntax/help, unchanged-config ESLint and whitespace checks pass. Real Chromium against task-owned loopback fixtures produced all 40 samples; a login-redirect fixture produced eight FAIL rows and exit 1. These validate the tool only; no authenticated Tolra app baseline or production timing claimed.

Handover: docs/handover/BUILDER-6-L2.md. Based on 9c3f5c6 and targets the pinned review branch; no original builder branch changes, main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
